ideas.title: Minnesota's Failure to Address Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the systemic issues within Minnesota's Department of Human Services that allowed a large-scale autism billing scheme to go unchecked for decades.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and identify key officials responsible for the oversight failures
questions: What officials were responsible for oversight?
How much money was lost to fraud?
What changes have been made to prevent future fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and shed light on the systemic issues within Minnesota's Department of Human Services.
